one_line: The paper develops and applies energy performance indicators (metering of compressed air, chilled water, HVAC) in a multinational biomedical device manufacturing facility involving casting, grinding, cleaning and polishing — discrete manufacturing, not continuous-flow production; petroleum/petrochemical sectors appear only as a passing benchmarking citation.
